title: Hip East Nashville house walking dist to top eats.
description:
Recently renovated 2 BR/2 BA in the heart of East Nashville, Nashville's hippest neighborhood. The house features luxury modern amenities and an open floor plan with charming rustic features.

The space
This classic home was fully renovated this year and features original hardwood floors, subway tile, industrial fixtures, and plenty of foliage.

Additional highlights include:
* Smart TV 
* Full kitchen & dining table, perfect for entertaining
* Private parking in rear underneath the protected carport
* Comfortable sofa bed in main living space for additional guests
* Walking distance to hot spots like Mas Tacos, The Pharmacy, and Barista Parlor.
* Washer & dryer
